name: Higashikagura (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Higashikagura town emblem in green: a stylised letter C with a leaf-shaped upper stroke.
history: Municipal flag of Higashikagura, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 January 1993.

features.role: Higashikagura town emblem — a stylised letter C with a leaf-shaped upper stroke
